_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-08-01 · SkyUnit — Implementation Funding: headcount out of the model, the P1/P2/P3 numbers fixed (they were 30× off), and the FTES rate is now an editable variable
_status: Implementation Funding had a real display bug: the priority cards were showing raw UNITS while calling them students and comparing them to an FTES target, so P1 read '193,700% of target'. Fixed — it now reads CPL FTES everywhere, and the college table's SYSTEM row no longer prints a headcount under a 'Credit FTES' header. Headcount is out of the model: the old '$4.62 per student' card is now the reimbursement rate, $5,649.63 per CPL FTES (= 2,057 CPL FTES a year's funding buys), and that rate is now an editable box you can change yourself. Per Sam's call, Priority 1 will move off ELIGIBLE units onto APPLIED units — eligible is inflated upstream by Marine Corps JSTs listing the same credit under every skill level, and applied doesn't double-count. The data for that publishes on tomorrow's daily run. The CCR/unified-courses and Budget items below are unchanged — those lanes still hold the curation queue.

items.text: 🆕 Priority 1 is moving from ELIGIBLE units to APPLIED units, on your call — applied doesn't carry the Marine Corps JST double-count. The statewide picture: 1,354,527 eligible → 242,559 applied → 103,139 transcribed. The per-college split publishes on the next daily run; worth a look before we lock the new targets, because right now 79 of 99 colleges have ZERO transcribed CPL in MAP and the top 10 hold 95.7% of it. Applied should spread that out a lot — but let's see the real numbers.

✅ The reimbursement rate ($5,649.63 per CPL FTES) is now an editable box — on the Funding pools card and in the FTES factors panel. Worth knowing before you turn the dial: raising the rate LOWERS every college's target (the target is just their allocation ÷ the rate). A zero is rejected rather than saved, because a 0 rate would silently drop every college to $0 earned.

After the 06:17 cron publishes pa/pa_u: wire P1 → Applied (a metric-string change in the live config — the MEASURES entry already exists) and make targets CUMULATIVE (drop the ÷nYears in prioEntitlement, routed through prioTarget — don't open-code it). Measure the per-college distribution BEFORE locking it. Then the Budget consolidation.
